§6Pressurizer§f

§aApplies extreme pressure to compact materials.§f
The §bPressurizer§f takes §b1 item input§f and produces §b1 output§f. Default cycle is §b600 ticks§f at §b40 RF/t§f. It's used for compacting materials under pressure, creating dense plates and compressed variants that can't be made any other way.

The Pressurizer is power-hungry at 40 RF/t, same as the Melter. But it produces materials essential for advanced recipes and reactor components. You'll need it for certain plate and component recipes.

§ePS:§f The Pressurizer loses progress on interruption. Keep your item supply steady to avoid wasted cycles and power consumption. A hopper or duct feeding items in helps a lot.
